title: The value of travel | Rick Steves | TEDxRainier
speaker: TEDx Talks
zh: 【TEDx Talks】旅行的價值|瑞克史蒂夫斯 | TEDx雷尼爾（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Translator: Natalie Thibault Reviewer: Sarah El_Gayyar
cues.en: Translator: Natalie Thibault Reviewer: Sarah El_Gayyar
cues.zh: 譯者：Natalie Thibault 審稿人：Sarah El_Gayyar

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝。

cues.text: You know, I have spent a third of my adult life living out of a suitcase.
cues.en: You know, I have spent a third of my adult life living out of a suitcase.
cues.zh: 你知道，我成年後三分之一的時間都在行李箱裡度過。

cues.text: And looking back on those 30 years, four months every year of traveling,
cues.en: And looking back on those 30 years, four months every year of traveling,
cues.zh: 回顧這30年，每年四個月的旅行，

cues.text: it occurs to me, it's really clear that travel, thoughtful travel, is well worth the time and the money.
cues.en: it occurs to me, it's really clear that travel, thoughtful travel, is well worth the time and the money.
cues.zh: 我覺得，很明顯，旅行，深思熟慮的旅行，是非常值得花時間和金錢的。

cues.text: And I'd like to take just a few minutes to explain to you why.
cues.en: And I'd like to take just a few minutes to explain to you why.
cues.zh: 我想花幾分鐘向您解釋原因。

cues.text: Travel opens us up to the wonders of our world.
cues.en: Travel opens us up to the wonders of our world.
cues.zh: 旅行讓我們領略世界的奇蹟。

cues.text: In so many ways, it helps you appreciate nature.
cues.en: In so many ways, it helps you appreciate nature.
cues.zh: 在很多方面，它可以幫助您欣賞大自然。

cues.text: I mean for me, a great day is walking high in the Swiss Alps, like tightroping on a ridge,
cues.en: I mean for me, a great day is walking high in the Swiss Alps, like tightroping on a ridge,
cues.zh: 我的意思是對我來說，美好的一天就是在瑞士阿爾卑斯山高處行走，就像在山脊上走鋼索一樣，

cues.text: on one side I've got lakes stretching all the way to Germany, on the other side the most incredible alpine panorama anywhere,
cues.en: on one side I've got lakes stretching all the way to Germany, on the other side the most incredible alpine panorama anywhere,
cues.zh: 一側有一直延伸到德國的湖泊，另一側則是世界上最令人難以置信的高山全景，

cues.text: the Eiger Mönch Jungfrau: cut glass peaks against that blue sky.
cues.en: the Eiger Mönch Jungfrau: cut glass peaks against that blue sky.
cues.zh: 艾格峰與尚少女峰：藍天映襯下的切割玻璃山峰。

cues.text: And ahead of me I hear the long legato tones of an alphorn announcing that the helicopter-stocked mountain hut is open,
cues.en: And ahead of me I hear the long legato tones of an alphorn announcing that the helicopter-stocked mountain hut is open,
cues.zh: 在我前面，我聽到阿爾卑斯號的長連音，宣佈裝有直升機的山間小屋已經開放，

cues.text: it's just around the corner and the coffee schnapps is on.
cues.en: it's just around the corner and the coffee schnapps is on.
cues.zh: 就在轉角處，咖啡琴酒已經上桌了。

cues.text: That connects you with nature, and that connects you with culture.
cues.en: That connects you with nature, and that connects you with culture.
cues.zh: 這將您與自然聯絡起來，並將您與文化聯絡起來。

cues.text: And when I'm traveling I love this whole idea that travel connects us with culture.
cues.en: And when I'm traveling I love this whole idea that travel connects us with culture.
cues.zh: 當我旅行時，我喜歡旅行將我們與文化聯絡起來的整個想法。

cues.text: When I am traveling I find that there are different slices of culture that I never realized people could be evangelical about.
cues.en: When I am traveling I find that there are different slices of culture that I never realized people could be evangelical about.
cues.zh: 當我旅行時，我發現有一些我從未意識到人們可以傳福音的不同文化。

cues.text: Cheese, for instance.
cues.en: Cheese, for instance.
cues.zh: 以乳酪為例。

cues.text: You go to France and they're crazy about cheese!
cues.en: You go to France and they're crazy about cheese!
cues.zh: 你去法國，他們對起司很著迷！

cues.text: I like being a bumpkin in my travels.
cues.en: I like being a bumpkin in my travels.
cues.zh: 我喜歡在旅行中當鄉巴佬。

cues.text: For me, cheese was always just orange and in the shape of the bread.
cues.en: For me, cheese was always just orange and in the shape of the bread.
cues.zh: 對我來說，起司總是橘色的，呈現麵包的形狀。

cues.text: There you go: cheese sandwich.
cues.en: There you go: cheese sandwich.
cues.zh: 給你：起司三明治。

cues.text: Then I meet these people and, I mean, there's a different cheese for every day of the year!
cues.en: Then I meet these people and, I mean, there's a different cheese for every day of the year!
cues.zh: 然後我遇到了這些人，我的意思是，一年中的每一天都有不同的起司！

cues.text: You step into a cheese shop and it's just a festival of mold.
cues.en: You step into a cheese shop and it's just a festival of mold.
cues.zh: 當你走進一家起司店時，你會發現這簡直就是黴菌的節日。

cues.text: I love going shopping with my Parisian friends, they'll take me into a cheese shop, put up a moldy wad of goat cheese
cues.en: I love going shopping with my Parisian friends, they'll take me into a cheese shop, put up a moldy wad of goat cheese
cues.zh: 我喜歡和我的巴黎朋友一起去購物，他們會帶我去一家起司店，放一團發黴的山羊起司

cues.text: take a deep whiff: "Oh Rick! Smell this cheese! It smells like the feet of angels!"
cues.en: take a deep whiff: "Oh Rick! Smell this cheese! It smells like the feet of angels!"
cues.zh: 深深地吸了一口：“哦，瑞克！聞聞這個乳酪！聞起來像天使的腳！”

cues.text: Okay! Well when you're traveling you open up to new things that might smell like the feet of angels.
cues.en: Okay! Well when you're traveling you open up to new things that might smell like the feet of angels.
cues.zh: 好的！好吧，當你旅行時，你會接觸新事物，這些新事物可能聞起來像天使的腳。

cues.text: A great thing about travel is that it connects you with people.
cues.en: A great thing about travel is that it connects you with people.
cues.zh: 旅行的一大好處是它可以將您與人們聯絡起來。

cues.text: And, if I am making a tour, or a guidebook or a TV show, and I am not connecting people with people
cues.en: And, if I am making a tour, or a guidebook or a TV show, and I am not connecting people with people
cues.zh: 而且，如果我正在旅遊、製作旅遊指南或電視節目，而我並沒有將人與人聯絡起來

cues.text: I am kind of nervous, because it's going to be a flat experience.
cues.en: I am kind of nervous, because it's going to be a flat experience.
cues.zh: 我有點緊張，因為這會是一次平淡的經驗。

cues.text: It's people that really make your experience vital.
cues.en: It's people that really make your experience vital.
cues.zh: 真正讓您的體驗變得至關重要的是人。

cues.text: That's the mark of a good trip.
cues.en: That's the mark of a good trip.
cues.zh: 這是一次愉快旅行的標誌。

cues.text: It doesn't need to be earth-shaking encounters, they can be just silly encounters.
cues.en: It doesn't need to be earth-shaking encounters, they can be just silly encounters.
cues.zh: 不需要是驚天動地的遭遇，它們可以只是愚蠢的遭遇。

cues.text: I was in Italy recently and I met this little kid.
cues.en: I was in Italy recently and I met this little kid.
cues.zh: 我最近在義大利，遇到了這個小孩。

cues.text: He was just staring at me, he was kind of rude.
cues.en: He was just staring at me, he was kind of rude.
cues.zh: 他只是盯著我看，有點粗魯。

cues.text: Finally his dad said: "Excuse my son, he stares at Americans."
cues.en: Finally his dad said: "Excuse my son, he stares at Americans."
cues.zh: 最後他爸爸說：“對不起，我的兒子，他盯著美國人看。”

cues.text: I said: "Why's that?" and he said: "Last week, we were at McDonald's having our hamburger,
cues.en: I said: "Why's that?" and he said: "Last week, we were at McDonald's having our hamburger,
cues.zh: 我說：「為什麼呢？」他說：「上週，我們在麥當勞吃漢堡，

cues.text: and my son, noticing the fluffy white bun, said: "Dad?
cues.en: and my son, noticing the fluffy white bun, said: "Dad?
cues.zh: 我的兒子注意到了蓬鬆的白麵包，說：「爸爸？

cues.text: Why do Americans have such soft bread?" and the dad said: "Son, that's because Americans have no teeth."
cues.en: Why do Americans have such soft bread?" and the dad said: "Son, that's because Americans have no teeth."
cues.zh: 為什麼美國人的麵包這麼軟？爸爸說：「兒子，那是因為美國人沒有牙齒。 」

cues.text: So, I showed him my teeth and I sort of straightened out a little misunderstanding
cues.en: So, I showed him my teeth and I sort of straightened out a little misunderstanding
cues.zh: 所以，我向他展示了我的牙齒，我有點澄清了一些誤會

cues.text: between peoples there and it occurred to me: that there are so many misunderstandings between people,
cues.en: between peoples there and it occurred to me: that there are so many misunderstandings between people,
cues.zh: 那裡的人與人之間，我突然想到：人與人之間有這麼多的誤解，

cues.text: and when we travel we straighten them out.
cues.en: and when we travel we straighten them out.
cues.zh: 當我們旅行時，我們會把它們理順。

cues.text: I don't know about you, but I was raised thinking the world is a pyramid, with us on top and everybody else trying to figure it out.
cues.en: I don't know about you, but I was raised thinking the world is a pyramid, with us on top and everybody else trying to figure it out.
cues.zh: 我不瞭解你的想法，但我從小就認為世界是一座金字塔，我們位於金字塔的頂端，其他人都在試圖弄清楚它。

cues.text: Then I travelled and I realized we have the American dream, that's a great thing, but other people have their own dream.
cues.en: Then I travelled and I realized we have the American dream, that's a great thing, but other people have their own dream.
cues.zh: 然後我去旅行，我意識到我們有美國夢，這是一件偉大的事情，但其他人有他們自己的夢想。

cues.text: Norwegians have the Norwegian dream. Bulgarians have the Bulgarian dream.
cues.en: Norwegians have the Norwegian dream. Bulgarians have the Bulgarian dream.
cues.zh: 挪威人有挪威夢。保加利亞人有保加利亞夢。

cues.text: These people have the Sri Lankan dream.
cues.en: These people have the Sri Lankan dream.
cues.zh: 這些人有斯里蘭卡夢。

cues.text: Travel wallops my ethnocentricity, and I'm very thankful for that. It's something to celebrate!
cues.en: Travel wallops my ethnocentricity, and I'm very thankful for that. It's something to celebrate!
cues.zh: 旅行打擊了我的民族中心主義，對此我非常感激。這是值得慶祝的事！

cues.text: Our dream is beautiful, but so is theirs.
cues.en: Our dream is beautiful, but so is theirs.
cues.zh: 我們的夢想很美好，他們的也一樣美好。

cues.text: In my travels I have really been impressed by the amount of pride on this planet.
cues.en: In my travels I have really been impressed by the amount of pride on this planet.
cues.zh: 在我的旅行中，我對這個星球上的自豪感印象深刻。

cues.text: Wonderful pride.
cues.en: Wonderful pride.
cues.zh: 美妙的驕傲。

cues.text: I was in Afghanistan once, in a cafeteria where the backpackers were hanging out,
cues.en: I was in Afghanistan once, in a cafeteria where the backpackers were hanging out,
cues.zh: 我曾經去過阿富汗，在揹包客們閒逛的自助餐廳裡，

cues.text: a man sat down next to me and said: "Can I join you?", I said: "You already have."
cues.en: a man sat down next to me and said: "Can I join you?", I said: "You already have."
cues.zh: 一個人在我旁邊坐下，說：“我可以加入你嗎？”，我說：“你已經加入了。”

cues.text: "You're an American, aren't you?" I said: "Yeah", "I'm a professor here in Afghanistan,
cues.en: "You're an American, aren't you?" I said: "Yeah", "I'm a professor here in Afghanistan,
cues.zh: “你是美國人，不是嗎？”我說：“是的”，“我是阿富汗的教授，

cues.text: I want you to know that a third of the people on this planet eat with spoons and forks like you do.
cues.en: I want you to know that a third of the people on this planet eat with spoons and forks like you do.
cues.zh: 我想讓你知道，這個星球上有三分之一的人像你一樣用湯匙和叉子吃飯。

cues.text: A third of the people eat with chopsticks, and a third eat with their fingers, like I do,
cues.en: A third of the people eat with chopsticks, and a third eat with their fingers, like I do,
cues.zh: 三分之一的人用筷子吃飯，三分之一的人用手指吃飯，就像我一樣，

cues.text: and we are all civilized just the same".
cues.en: and we are all civilized just the same".
cues.zh: 我們都是同樣文明的人」。

cues.text: He had a chip on his shoulder.
cues.en: He had a chip on his shoulder.
cues.zh: 他的肩膀上有一個晶片。

cues.text: He thought I thought less of him because he ate with his fingers.
cues.en: He thought I thought less of him because he ate with his fingers.
cues.zh: 他以為我因為他用手指吃飯而看不起他。

cues.text: That lesson stuck with me and for the rest of my trip through South Asia I was aware of that.
cues.en: That lesson stuck with me and for the rest of my trip through South Asia I was aware of that.
cues.zh: 這個教訓一直困擾著我，在我接下來的南亞之旅中我也意識到了這一點。

cues.text: I went to restaurants, fine restaurants with well-dressed professional local people that had no spoons and forks.
cues.en: I went to restaurants, fine restaurants with well-dressed professional local people that had no spoons and forks.
cues.zh: 我去了餐館，高階餐館裡有穿著考究的專業當地人，但沒有湯匙和叉子。

cues.text: They had like a ceremonial sink in the middle of the restaurant, people would wash their hands and eat using their fingers
cues.en: They had like a ceremonial sink in the middle of the restaurant, people would wash their hands and eat using their fingers
cues.zh: 他們在餐廳中間有一個儀式水槽，人們會洗手並用手指吃飯

cues.text: the way God intended them to be used.
cues.en: the way God intended them to be used.
cues.zh: 上帝希望它們被使用的方式。

cues.text: It actually became quite natural for me.
cues.en: It actually became quite natural for me.
cues.zh: 這對我來說實際上變得很自然。

cues.text: I had to be re-trained when I got home.
cues.en: I had to be re-trained when I got home.
cues.zh: 回家後我必須重新接受訓練。

cues.text: But these are the lessons you pick up and it is so fun to change something that you thought was a basic truth.
cues.en: But these are the lessons you pick up and it is so fun to change something that you thought was a basic truth.
cues.zh: 但這些都是你學到的教訓，改變你認為是基本事實的東西是非常有趣的。

cues.text: Well, in the adulthood you realize: Hey! Other people, smart people, can see it differently.
cues.en: Well, in the adulthood you realize: Hey! Other people, smart people, can see it differently.
cues.zh: 好吧，成年後你會意識到：嘿！其他人，聰明的人，會有不同的看法。

cues.text: I'm impressed how many heroic struggles are going on this planet all the time
cues.en: I'm impressed how many heroic struggles are going on this planet all the time
cues.zh: 令我印象深刻的是，這個星球上一直在進行著多少英勇的鬥爭

cues.text: that I am completely oblivious to.
cues.en: that I am completely oblivious to.
cues.zh: 我完全沒有註意到。

cues.text: Every year, eight or ten distinct languages go extinct.
cues.en: Every year, eight or ten distinct languages go extinct.
cues.zh: 每年都有八到十種不同的語言滅絕。

cues.text: That's eight or ten ethnic groups that lose a long struggle.
cues.en: That's eight or ten ethnic groups that lose a long struggle.
cues.zh: 那是八個或十個民族在長期鬥爭中失敗了。

cues.text: I was raised thinking Nathan Hale, Ethan Allen, Patrick Henry they were the ultimate. Ah!
cues.en: I was raised thinking Nathan Hale, Ethan Allen, Patrick Henry they were the ultimate. Ah!
cues.zh: 我從小就認為內森·黑爾、伊森·艾倫、派崔克·亨利是終極的。啊!

cues.text: Well you know they are great, but they're certainly not unique.
cues.en: Well you know they are great, but they're certainly not unique.
cues.zh: 你知道它們很棒，但它們肯定不是獨一無二的。

cues.text: They're a dime a dozen on this planet.
cues.en: They're a dime a dozen on this planet.
cues.zh: 他們在這個星球上是一毛錢一打。

cues.text: It doesn't diminish ours but it's really important for us to remember in our travels that there are other heroes and other causes.
cues.en: It doesn't diminish ours but it's really important for us to remember in our travels that there are other heroes and other causes.
cues.zh: 它不會削弱我們的英雄，但對我們來說，在旅行中記住還有其他英雄和其他事業非常重要。

cues.text: One great way to make your travels more meaningful is to relate to, to embrace a contemporary Nathan Hale,
cues.en: One great way to make your travels more meaningful is to relate to, to embrace a contemporary Nathan Hale,
cues.zh: 讓你的旅行更有意義的一個好方法是與當代的內森黑爾建立聯絡，擁抱他，

cues.text: in a different country. Get into it.
cues.en: in a different country. Get into it.
cues.zh: 在另一個國家。進入其中。

cues.text: An easy one is: Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.en: An easy one is: Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.zh: 一個簡單的例子是：大主教奧斯卡羅梅羅。

cues.text: Go down to San Salvador, El Salvador, and learn about Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.en: Go down to San Salvador, El Salvador, and learn about Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.zh: 前往薩爾瓦多聖薩爾瓦多，瞭解大主教奧斯卡羅梅羅。

cues.text: A present-day Nathan Hale.
cues.en: A present-day Nathan Hale.
cues.zh: 現在的內森·黑爾。

cues.text: A few years ago I was due for a vacation. I was heading for Mazatlán, and I was just needy for a nice stretch of pristine beach,
cues.en: A few years ago I was due for a vacation. I was heading for Mazatlán, and I was just needy for a nice stretch of pristine beach,
cues.zh: 幾年前，我本來要去度假。我正前往馬薩特蘭，我只是需要一片美麗的原始海灘，

cues.text: swept free of local riffraff.
cues.en: swept free of local riffraff.
cues.zh: 掃除了當地的痞子。

cues.text: I was gonna have a plastic strap on my wrist, giving me unlimited margaritas,
cues.en: I was gonna have a plastic strap on my wrist, giving me unlimited margaritas,
cues.zh: 我的手腕上有一條塑膠帶，可以給我無限量的瑪格麗特酒，

cues.text: never have to dirty my fingers with coins, you know what that's like, I was ready.
cues.en: never have to dirty my fingers with coins, you know what that's like, I was ready.
cues.zh: 永遠不必用硬幣弄髒我的手指，你知道那是什麼感覺，我已經準備好了。

cues.text: And then some friends invited me to go to San Salvador for the 25th anniversary of the assassination of Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.en: And then some friends invited me to go to San Salvador for the 25th anniversary of the assassination of Archbishop Oscar Romero.
cues.zh: 然後一些朋友邀請我去聖薩爾瓦多參加大主教奧斯卡·羅梅羅被刺殺25週年。

cues.text: He marched with his people.
cues.en: He marched with his people.
cues.zh: 他與他的人民一起遊行。

cues.text: He stood by his people during the Civil war that they lost.
cues.en: He stood by his people during the Civil war that they lost.
cues.zh: 在內戰期間，他與人民站在一起，但他們失敗了。

cues.text: These were the landless peasants.
cues.en: These were the landless peasants.
cues.zh: 這些人就是失地農民。

cues.text: He said: "I'll probably be killed, and when I'm killed I'll raise again in my people".
cues.en: He said: "I'll probably be killed, and when I'm killed I'll raise again in my people".
cues.zh: 他說：「我可能會被殺，當我被殺時，我會在我的人民中再次復活」。

cues.text: And I wanted to see Romero in his people,
cues.en: And I wanted to see Romero in his people,
cues.zh: 我想在他的人民中看到羅梅羅，

cues.text: 25 years after his assassination.
cues.en: 25 years after his assassination.
cues.zh: 他被刺殺 25 年後。

cues.text: And I went to El Salvador. Two days into that trip I was covered with bug bites,
cues.en: And I went to El Salvador. Two days into that trip I was covered with bug bites,
cues.zh: 我去了薩爾瓦多。那次旅行兩天後我全身被蟲咬了，

cues.text: in a sweaty dorm bunk bed, eating rice and beans one day and beans and rice the next,
cues.en: in a sweaty dorm bunk bed, eating rice and beans one day and beans and rice the next,
cues.zh: 在汗流浹背的宿舍雙層床上，一天吃米飯和豆子，第二天吃豆子和米飯，

cues.text: and I was having the greatest travel experience you can ever have.
cues.en: and I was having the greatest travel experience you can ever have.
cues.zh: 我正在享受有史以來最棒的旅行體驗。

cues.zh: 我旋轉，我旋轉，我迷失在對梅烏拉那教義的轉變思考中」。

cues.text: To be there as tour guide with my group, watching him, his head tilted over his robe, then goes out,
cues.en: To be there as tour guide with my group, watching him, his head tilted over his robe, then goes out,
cues.zh: 作為我的團隊的導遊，看著他，他的頭傾斜在他的長袍上，然後出去，

cues.text: and he loses himself in that beautiful path.
cues.en: and he loses himself in that beautiful path.
cues.zh: 他在那條美麗的道路上迷失了自己。

cues.text: I thought: "Wow, I am really understanding now, like my group was,
cues.en: I thought: "Wow, I am really understanding now, like my group was,
cues.zh: 我想：「哇，我現在真的理解了，就像我的團隊一樣，

cues.text: that this man is very different from us, but he is fundamentally the same.
cues.en: that this man is very different from us, but he is fundamentally the same.
cues.zh: 這個人與我們非常不同，但本質上是一樣的。

cues.text: And if we take home that understanding, that's the very best souvenir possible.
cues.en: And if we take home that understanding, that's the very best souvenir possible.
cues.zh: 如果我們把這種理解帶回家，那就是最好的紀念品。

cues.text: And the rest of our lives, when we look at the rest of the world,
cues.en: And the rest of our lives, when we look at the rest of the world,
cues.zh: 而我們的餘生，當我們放眼世界其他地方時，

cues.text: rather than fear its diversity, we can better celebrate it.
cues.en: rather than fear its diversity, we can better celebrate it.
cues.zh: 與其害怕它的多樣性，我們可以更好地慶祝它。

cues.text: Now, appreciating the value of travel is nothing new.
cues.en: Now, appreciating the value of travel is nothing new.
cues.zh: 現在，認識到旅行的價值已經不是什麼新鮮事了。

cues.text: 1400 years ago Mohammed said: "Don't tell me how educated you are, tell me how much you've traveled".
cues.en: 1400 years ago Mohammed said: "Don't tell me how educated you are, tell me how much you've traveled".
cues.zh: 1400 年前，穆罕默德說：「不要告訴我你受過多少教育，告訴我你旅行過多少地方」。

cues.text: Thomas Jefferson traveled and he wrote that travel makes a person wiser, if less happy.
cues.en: Thomas Jefferson traveled and he wrote that travel makes a person wiser, if less happy.
cues.zh: 託馬斯·傑斐遜旅行過，他寫道，旅行使人變得更聰明，儘管不那麼快樂。

cues.text: Mark Twain traveled and he famously wrote: "Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry and narrow-mindedness".
cues.en: Mark Twain traveled and he famously wrote: "Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry and narrow-mindedness".
cues.zh: 馬克吐溫曾經旅行過，他有句名言：「旅行對於偏見、偏執和狹隘來說是致命的」。

cues.text: I've traveled and travel has inspired me to be engaged,
cues.en: I've traveled and travel has inspired me to be engaged,
cues.zh: 我旅行過，旅行激勵我訂婚，

cues.text: and to do what I can to make a difference.
cues.en: and to do what I can to make a difference.
cues.zh: 並盡我所能改變現狀。

cues.text: In other words, it's helped me to become a better citizen of this planet.
cues.en: In other words, it's helped me to become a better citizen of this planet.
cues.zh: 換句話說，它幫助我成為這個星球上更好的公民。

cues.text: And I hope thoughtful travels can do the same for you.
cues.en: And I hope thoughtful travels can do the same for you.
cues.zh: 我希望深思熟慮的旅行也能為您帶來同樣的效果。

cues.text: Thank you very much.
cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝。
